name: High Torque Robotics
summary: High Torque Robotics is a Guangzhou-based robotics company developing compact humanoid research platforms, servo joint modules and robotic arms. Its Mini Pi Plus platform is intended for scientific research, teaching and robot competitions. The company emphasizes modular hardware and an open software ecosystem for developers, with Python and C++ interfaces, ROS support and simulation resources. The current official Chinese website identifies the business as Guangzhou High Torque Power Technology Co., Ltd. (Guangzhou Gaoqing Dynamics Technology Co., Ltd.), trading as Gaoqing Dynamics.
